notes: Adds a separate top-level YMS CRM workspace and bulk email logging from Prospects. Prospects now supports multi-select checkboxes plus Select visible, Clear and Emailed ✓ controls. Clicking Emailed ✓ processes the selected companies through the existing manual sent-email workflow, automatically adds successful items to CRM, and schedules the next follow-up at 3 / 5 / 10 working days based on previous logged attempts. CRM is no longer embedded inside Outreach and has Due now, Overdue, Waiting, Replies and In CRM views, search, follow-up status, logged attempt counts and a due badge. Existing prospect data, Product Intelligence, Outreach history, branding and Smart Pipeline are retained. This package can upgrade directly from 5.0.3 or 5.0.5.
